auditVerdict: PASS FOR PHASE 10 RELEASE — Direct browser Google Drive v3 REST client under GIS token model and minimal drive.file scope, Commit-Manifest-Last 5-step transactional protocol engine, 256KB-aligned resumable chunked uploader (>5MB) with token-expiration pause/resume and QuotaExceeded fallback, and optimistic concurrency conflict resolver with non-destructive 'Save Both' duplicate creation fully implemented and verified. 54/54 master test suites passed (100%), including 21/21 Playwright visual regressions, 0 sitemap drift, and 0 broken links.
warningsRecorded: Remotion Commercial License Gate: Evaluated under Remotion Terms. Bounded behind pluggable RenderAdapter interface; default rendering engine set to Native HTML5 Canvas + WebCodecs (VideoEncoder/AudioEncoder) + Web Audio + WASM Muxer to ensure zero recurring software license cost under rule G-02.

Static QR / Physical Print Immutability: Standard static vCard QR codes printed on physical paper/cards cannot be remotely altered. Dynamic URLs require user-controlled domain/hosting; AnyConverter hosts zero public user profile endpoints under zero-backend rule G-01.

Flattened AI Video Editability: Flattened AI-generated MP4 footage cannot be directly disassembled into vector layers. Users are given explicit choices: add overlays/masks, selectively regenerate the specific shot with user approval, or cancel.

Local Encrypted Storage XSS Threat Model: Client-side PBKDF2/AES-GCM encryption protects stored keys against offline disk theft, but cannot protect against malicious scripts (XSS) executing in the same origin when unlocked. Session-only mode recommended on untrusted hardware.
Kaggle Policy: Public unattended automated orchestration of Kaggle workflows remains disabled pending written authorization; personal user-driven notebook execution supported.

Drive Quota & Token Immutability: AnyConverter hosts zero user media files or storage buckets. Storage quota belongs strictly to the user's Google Drive. Tokens are kept in memory only; connecting or disconnecting Google Drive never mutates or overwrites local IndexedDB drafts.
